name: nextc-hud
description: Heads-up display mod: an always-on row above the prompt (context, compactions, cost estimate, rate limits, agents, live runs) with /hud actions that prepare a /compact or a handoff in the prompt box, a project run monitor for builds, explores, ASO and kickoff runs (/hud watch), an autopilot run monitor (/autopilot-watch), and a 'used this turn' line. Observe-only.

always_on_row.title: Always-on session row
always_on_row.description: One row above the prompt: context used, compactions, cost estimate, rate limits, agents and live project runs. /hud off hides it for one session.

auto_watch.title: Open the run pane by itself
auto_watch.description: When a build, explore, ASO or kickoff run starts in this project, open its read-only pane without /hud watch. The pane collapses to one line once the run's outcome has left the row and expands again for the next run; it is never closed for you. Needs the row on.

heavy_percent.title: Heavy at context %
heavy_percent.description: The row turns to 'heavy' (warning colour, two actions) once context passes this share of the window. From 1 to 100; a value outside is clamped.

act_percent.title: Act now at context %
act_percent.description: The row says 'act now' once context passes this share of the window. From 1 to 100; a value outside is clamped.

heavy_tokens.title: Heavy at tokens
heavy_tokens.description: Also 'heavy' once context passes this many tokens, whatever the window (useful on a 1M window). 0 turns this off.

act_compactions.title: Act now after compactions
act_compactions.description: The row says 'act now' from this many compactions in one session.

coach_toasts.title: Coach toasts
coach_toasts.description: One toast per threshold crossing per session (heavy, act now, repeated compactions). /hud coach off silences them for one session.

toasts_when_hidden.title: Coach toasts while the row is hidden
toasts_when_hidden.description: Also toast when the row is off, hidden or collapsed. Off: a hidden row stays quiet.

show_used_line.title: Show the 'used this turn' line
show_used_line.description: Under each answer, one line naming the skills and subagents that turn used. Nothing is shown for a turn that used neither.

autopilot_toasts.title: Autopilot toasts
autopilot_toasts.description: While /autopilot-watch follows a run, a toast once when it ends, stalls, uses 80% of its decider calls, or has under 15% of its budget left.
